The band looks high against shore engineering and the comparison is not like for like. Sea pay is earned in contract cycles rather than twelve months a year, is substantially tax-advantaged for Indian seafarers meeting the days-outside-India condition, and is paid against months away from home in confined machinery spaces. It is not a higher salary for the same life.

Settled in Engineering & Making rather than Design & Creative Arts. Architecture is more than design: it is licensed, load-bearing and legally accountable for whether a building stands. The CoA Minimum Standards of Architectural Education Regulations 2020 require class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics at 45% aggregate in PCM, plus NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A; the only alternative is a 10+3 diploma with Mathematics. path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics with 60 percent aggregate and 50 percent in English. Medical standard is absolute: 6/6 vision without aids and no colour blindness.
IMU CET or a DG Shipping approved institute's admission, plus a company sponsorship test.

Either a one-year Diploma in Nautical Science or a three-year B.Sc Nautical Science, at a DG Shipping approved institute. Both lead to the same certificate and both cost like a degree - the DNS is a one-year course priced in lakhs.
18 months of Structured Shipboard Training as a Deck Cadet. THIS REQUIRES A COMPANY SPONSORSHIP and is the real bottleneck.

Four months post-sea shore training, the STCW courses, and the Second Mates examination conducted by the Directorate General of Shipping. Passing awards the Second Mates (FG) Certificate of Competency.

public_routes: DG Shipping approved pre-sea training admissions
entrance_exams.note: The examination is not the constraint. COMPANY SPONSORSHIP for the 18 months of shipboard training is, and a student can complete the diploma and still be unable to proceed.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Very low exposure. Ships are increasingly automated and crewed by fewer people, but a certificated officer must be aboard and personally answerable for the safe navigation of the vessel under international convention. Autonomous shipping is real and slow, and the regulatory requirement for a licensed human on watch is what this profession rests on. Marine Surveyor Trainee and Port Operations Officer carry more exposure through documentation and inspection tooling.

nuances.statement: Tier A. The Second Mates (Foreign Going) Certificate of Competency is issued by the Directorate General of Shipping after its own examination, and serving as a deck officer without one is unlawful. This is the same statutory structure as the MEO certificates recorded for Marine Engineer in Sector 2.

The binding constraint is not academic. Eighteen months of shipboard training requires a shipping company to sponsor a cadet berth, and the number of berths is far smaller than the number of people completing pre-sea courses. Students routinely pay for a diploma and then cannot proceed. Any institute that does not guarantee sponsorship in writing should be treated with suspicion.

The cost of entry is the part students underestimate. A DG Shipping approved pre-sea course is priced in lakhs whether it is the one-year diploma or the three-year degree, it is paid up front, and it does not guarantee the cadet berth that the certificate depends on. Money spent before sponsorship is money at risk.

PCM is required and so is a MEDICAL standard that no other profession in this dataset imposes: uncorrected 6/6 vision and no colour blindness. That excludes a large number of academically eligible students, and it should be checked before any money is spent.

Set level with Marine Engineer in Sector 2 rather than above it. Deck and engine officers hold parallel Certificates of Competency on the same ship under the same international convention, and a gap between them was not defensible. The highest earnings in this sector by a wide margin, and they are earned at sea in tax-advantaged foreign-going service, away from home for months. Shore roles after sailing pay substantially less, which is the trade every officer eventually makes.

Built in Sector 16 and moved here on review. The substitution test decided it: remove travel and hospitality and a deck officer's work - navigation, watchkeeping, cargo, safety - survives completely unchanged, because a cargo ship carries no passengers to host. The setting was doing the work of a sector. It also ends a split that should never have existed: MARINE ENGINEER was already here, and the deck officer holds the parallel Certificate of Competency on the same ship. Two halves of one crew were in two different sectors.

admin_review.reason: The highest figure and the widest spread anywhere in Sectors 8 to 18 - 13 to 32 lakh - and entirely unsourced. A fetchable anchor exists and should be used: the NUSI-MUI and INSA collective bargaining wage scales publish monthly rates for a Third Officer on Indian-flag foreign-going ships, and ITF minimum scales cover the international floor. Sourcing it would make this the sector's one statutory-style anchor, as the Majithia award is for Sector 9.

professions.one_liner: Designs physical products - appliances, tools, vehicles, medical devices, furniture.

deviating_roles.why: Research is fieldwork and interviews - watching how people actually use a stove or a wheelchair. It sets the brief rather than answering it.
Prototyping is workshop craft - foam, wood, 3D printing and finishing. It is the hands-on trade inside a profession that is otherwise screen-based.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Physics and Maths help with the engineering side but are not required.
UCEED for the IITs, or NID DAT. Private design colleges admit on their own tests.
B.Des in Industrial or Product Design (4 years), or M.Des after any degree via CEED.
In-house design team at a manufacturer, or a product design consultancy.

entrance_exams.note: UCEED and NID DAT are the undergraduate routes; CEED is the postgraduate one and takes graduates of any discipline, which is how many engineers enter design.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and studio ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent design consultancy serving manufacturers, normally after 5-8 years in-house - the work comes from a network, not a portfolio site.

ai_exposure.reason: The least exposed design profession here, because the output has to survive manufacture. A model can generate a beautiful kettle; it cannot know the tooling budget, the draft angles, the certification regime or what the factory can actually make. CMF Designer and Packaging Structure Designer are the more exposed roles; Design Researcher and Model Maker & Prototyper are the least.

nuances.statement: UCEED is named as primary because for THIS profession the public design institutes really are the dominant route into the good jobs - unlike graphic or UI design, where entry is portfolio-led and the exam is irrelevant. 15,408 candidates for 245 seats is 62.9 to 1, harder than JEE Main.

Moderate, and the reason is structural: India manufactures at enormous scale but designs comparatively little of what it makes, because design authority for many products sits with the foreign brand owner. That is a real ceiling on the profession's size, not a comment on its quality.

Built in Sector 8 and moved here on review. The substitution test decides it: strip the styling and the object still has to be manufacturable, safe, durable and to cost - the engineering constraint is what survives, and it is what the job is actually bounded by. Its industrial tags were already CGSC, FFSC and ASDC: capital goods, furniture and automotive. THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT IS REAL AND IS WHY SECTOR 8 STILL POINTS HERE: the entrances are NID DAT and UCEED, which are design examinations, and a 15-year-old looking for this work will look under design, not under engineering. Placement follows the work; discoverability is the application's job.

routed_elsewhere.why: Craft is aesthetic and spatial design, not structural making. Architect stays here because it is licensed and structural.
Sector 2 is industrial and technical making. Sector 8 is craft and aesthetic making. Handloom weaving and pottery follow the same rule.
Kept with the agriculture value chain where students looking for farm careers will find it. Contestable — see boundary notes.
Writes code. Chip Design Engineer stays here because it designs hardware.
Purpose defines it — the goal is environmental outcomes, not the artefact.
Hosting people. Pilot stays here as licensed technical operation of complex machinery.
Craft and garment construction. Textile ENGINEERING — fibre, machinery, dyeing chemistry — stays here.
Uniformed public service under the cross-cutting rule, like Police Officer. The industrial fire prevention side stays here as Fire & Safety Engineer.

routed_elsewhere.goes_to: declined - already covered by Tool & Die Maker and Fitter & Machine Operator (S2)
routed_elsewhere.why: NCO family 8190. Tool & Die Maker and Fitter & Machine Operator already carry this work; sharpening and grinding is a task inside a trade, not a trade of its own.

merged_into.why: Solar PV installation is electrician skill plus a specialisation, and the roles were already duplicated across three professions. Findable via the Solar job roles and the SCGJ green-jobs tag.
Passed the interest-alignment half of the profession test but failed the separate-skill-set half. Findable via the vehicle job roles and the ASDC automotive tag.

Not a separate profession - a job role. Same object of concern and the same labour market, described from the service end instead of the design end. Identical mid-career midpoint. The only real difference was entry route, diploma versus degree, and a route is not a skill set. Contrast Electrician vs Electrical Engineer, which DO both stand: wiring a building and designing a grid are different daily work, not two ends of one job.

boundary_decisions_needing_your_signoff: ARCHITECT sits here, not in Design & Creative Arts. Reasoning: statutory CoA licence, PCM prerequisite, structural responsibility, and the output is a physical building. Interior and landscape DESIGN are routed to Sector 8, so the boundary is craft-versus-licensed-construction. This is the single most contestable placement in the sector.

COMMERCIAL PILOT and AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE ENGINEER sit here as licensed technical operation of machinery, while Cabin Crew goes to Hospitality. If you prefer an operations-versus-making split, both would move.

AGRICULTURAL ENGINEER routed to Sector 15 rather than kept here. The rule applied is that B.Tech branches normally live here, so this is a deliberate exception to keep Sector 15 substantive. Reverse it if you would rather all B.Tech branches sit together.

CHIP DESIGN ENGINEER is here rather than Sector 1 because it designs hardware; Embedded Software is in Sector 1 because it writes code. The two are adjacent and students may not see the difference from the names alone.

SKILLED TRADES are distributed inside this sector by degree_dependency = certificate, exactly as the brief specified, rather than being split into their own sector. Twelve of twenty-eight professions here are trades.

10.0: Added demand_signal { india_demand, pathway } — two ORTHOGONAL questions that were being conflated.

india_demand asks whether society needs this work. pathway asks where you can realistically train for it: 'india', 'any', or 'abroad'. A weak Indian pathway is NOT weak demand — India imports most medical devices, which is evidence of demand, not absence of it.
pathway deliberately does NOT rate Indian institutions as strong or weak. It states where the training exists, which is factual and actionable, rather than passing judgment on colleges.
